request: Operator requested a dedicated geometric algebra node. The claim and test below are proposed by marici.Grothendieck, not a recorded result.

proposed_node.title: Can a geometric algebra readout predict a legal marked move?
proposed_node.claim: On a declared family of path and port insertions, a rule on the parent and the proposed move, expressed in geometric algebra, predicts which marked moves are legal and gives the same decision after consistent relabeling.
proposed_node.criterion: Before a holdout test, fix the family, metric, map from parent incidences to blades, move encoding, frame action, scalar decision rule and treatment of ties. Do not use child colors or legality as inputs. Test individual moves, not totals, against direct triangle and blue-seven checks. Include shared-port and disjoint-port repairs with equal one-port move counts and a two-port probe that separates them. One incorrect prediction refutes the frozen rule on that family. Compare with a direct incidence rule on the same inputs; equal predictions alone do not show an advantage.

admission: Proposed only. The owner must admit the node and refresh and verify the net receipt. No change to root priority or status is requested.
